description: On the counter there’s a dark tray holding a TV remote, a colorful Rubik’s cube, and a pink-frosted donut, with a clear plastic container behind them and a slice of bread and a small blue cup off to the right. The left hand stays resting on the left side, while the right hand moves in from the right, grasps the donut as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward, and places it into the clear plastic container before releasing it.
